Ständige Einkünfte der Amtleute in der Grafschaft Diez, [um 1500]

Abstellung des gräflichen Haushalts zu Siegen, 1530

entries.english:
Volume 1

Contains: Instructions for the bailiff and cellar master at Siegen, [circa 1500]
Permanent revenues of the bailiffs in the County of Diez, [circa 1500]
Delivery of a clock from Oppenheim to Dillenburg Castle, 1528
Discontinuation of the count's household at Siegen, 1530
Appointment of Georg von Rosenberg as bailiff at Hanau, 1530
Contract with Master Jost of Marburg regarding a stone trough for the castle well at Dillenburg, 1527
